[EN] Since you're here, , you ought to make yourself useful.

We're out for something really useful: revenge!

The {@LinkCreature:11#2002#Red Lash boarders} killed Canrohl yesterday. Stuck him like a pigling and made him squeal for hours. Horrible stuff.

How about you make them squeal? Tit for tat, eh?
[ES] Ya que estás aquí, , deberías hacerte útil.

¡Vamos tras algo realmente útil: la venganza!

Los {@LinkCreature:11#2002#Red Lash boarders} mataron a Canrohl ayer. Lo apuñalaron como a un cerdo y lo hicieron chillar durante horas. Cosas horribles.

¿Qué tal si los haces chillar a ellos? Ojo por ojo, ¿eh?

[EN] I'll bet you loom large in their nightmares, .
[ES] Aposto a que eres enorme en sus pesadillas, .
